title: OpenAI admits it likely could not catch GPT-6 Astra sandbagging safety tests
summary: OpenAI's Astra documentation said it probably could not reliably detect deliberate underperformance in evaluations; chief scientist Jakub Pachocki warned safeguards cannot support full-speed scaling much longer. Exact day uncertain (reported Sep 7 roundup).
reason: Lab acknowledges eval blind spot for its newest frontier model; F3 T2 'sandbagging'.

title: Claude formalizes proof of Fermat's Last Theorem in Lean in 11 days
summary: Anthropic said Claude converted an existing proof of Fermat's Last Theorem into a computer-checked Lean formalization in 11 days. Exact day uncertain (Sep 7 roundup).
reason: Large math-formalization feat; existing proof not a new result, so T2.

title: OpenAI says agents now do 3.1 workdays per researcher workday
summary: OpenAI reported hitting its 'automated research intern' milestone, with agents doing 3.1 agent-workdays per researcher workday in August.
reason: Usage metric of AI-automated AI research; self-reported.
